title: GEMglDepthMask
description: enable or disable writing into the depth buffer

messages.description: whether the depth buffer is enabled for writing

arguments.description: whether the depth buffer is enabled for writing

body: [GEMglDepthMask] calls glDepthMask() each time a gemlist passes through it, with the parameters set by its creation arguments and inlets. See glDepthMask in the OpenGL reference.
